judgement.why: Zodgrod Wortsnagga leads the 20 Gretchin, the Runtherd supports them (the export’s associations; GW’s LEADER: GRETCHIN, the Runtherd’s SUPPORT: GRETCHIN). Super Runts (“This unit is riled up”, “This unit’s Scavenged Shivs weapons have +1 A, WS and S”): the attached unit, Core Rules 19.04. Extra Sneaky (Runt Swarm, UPGRADE: GRETCHIN unit only) is the Gretchin’s. That’ll Learn Ya in GW’s words (“This unit is no longer battle-shocked”; BSData: “That unit”).

Ten Gretchin with the Extra Sneaky upgrade (Runt Swarm, UPGRADE, “GRETCHIN unit only”; the export gives it to two Gretchin units, this one and Zodgrod’s): 45 + 10 pts. The other ten Gretchin (gretchin-2) have none.

Nazdreg leads five Meganobz with Kombi-weapons and Power Klaws (the export’s association; GW’s LEADER: MEGANOBZ). Nazdreg’s Know-wotz (“This unit has Deep Strike”, “This unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER]”) is for the attached unit (Core Rules 19.04): every model has Deep Strike (no partialRules), the Meganobz’ Kombi-weapon profiles carry [IGNORES COVER] as BSData applies it. Displays of Savagery (Bully Boyz: MEGANOBZ/NOBZ units’ melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]) on every melee weapon of the attached unit (it has MEGANOBZ). 175 pts: GW’s price of five Meganobz (1st to 2nd units).

The Warboss in Mega Armour leads six Meganobz with Twin Killsaws (the export’s association; GW’s LEADER: MEGANOBZ). Da Gobshot Thunderbuss (Brute Bosses, WARBOSS model only): “This model has the following weapon”: a ranged weapon of the Warboss (enh), checked against the enhancement’s profile. Twin Killsaw: New Recruit’s name for GW’s Twin Killsaws (“replaced with 1 Twin Killsaws”), one on each Meganob. Krushin’ Impetus: one D6 for each model of the attached unit engaged with that enemy unit (“each model in this unit”, Core Rules 19.04). Displays of Savagery on every melee weapon (MEGANOBZ). 115 pts (1st to 2nd units) + 20; Meganobz 210 (six, 1st to 2nd units) + 30 (Twin Killsaws, 5 each).

Brutal But Kunnin’ (Brute Bosses, WARBOSS model only: the Beastboss on Squigosaur is WARBOSS): “This model’s melee attacks have +1 D”: every melee weapon of the one model, the Squigosaur’s jaws too (the datasheet’s values kept as its own). Thump Gun: GW’s wargear option (“This model can be equipped with 1 Thump Gun”), taken. Thundering Stampede is GW’s (Aura). 140 pts (1st to 2nd units) + 30.

source.text: When a friendly **WARBOSS** model is **destroyed**, if this unit has not been **selected to fight** this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to the roll if your unit is **riled up**: …
source.reason: ’Ard as Nails: “When a friendly WARBOSS model is destroyed, if this unit has not been selected to fight this phase …”: a WARBOSS model can be destroyed in any phase of either turn (shooting, the Fight phase, mortal wounds) and the rule names none; derive.js reads only “selected to fight” (the Fight phase). As Fates in Flux (Tzeeeeentch).

The owner retired the lists Melee and Ooga booga for this one (“remove Melee Orks list and Ooga Booga lists, this is the new ultimate melee orks list”): these datasheet rows were theirs and are now this list’s alone; their signed-off facts (words, labels, When targeted lines, notes) stay the app’s, as for a row another list has (from-json.js keptRows).

GW’s datasheet (Wahapedia, the codex; Orks have no Faction Pack) prints “This unit is no longer battle-shocked”; BSData and the row (Ooga booga’s, signed off with BSData’s word) “That unit”. The row now has GW’s words (its only list is Simple but effective); BSData’s declared in deviations-bsdata.json (simple-but-effective · zodgrod-wortsnagga-runtherd-gretchin · ability.text).

GW’s YOUR UNIT COSTS: Ghazghkull 290, Mozrog 170, Nazdreg 165, Zodgrod 50, Runtherd 10 (single cost); Beastboss on Squigosaur 140 and Warboss in Mega Armour 115 (1st to 2nd units); Big Mek Dakkarig 160 (1st to 2nd units; this list has two); Meganobz 5 models 175, 6 models 210 (1st to 2nd units; two units); wargear Twin Killsaws 5 per model (6 × 5 = 30); Gretchin 10 models 45, 20 models 80; Deffkoptas 3 models 85 (1st to 2nd units). Enhancements (Wahapedia faction page): Brutal But Kunnin’ 30, Da Gobshot Thunderbuss 20 (Brute Bosses), Extra Sneaky 10 (Runt Swarm, UPGRADE, on two Gretchin units). Every value is the export’s; 2000 of 2000.

“Twin Killsaws” (GW, “replaced with 1 Twin Killsaws”) matched for New Recruit’s Twin Killsaw, one on each model: values checked, New Recruit’s name kept, listed as named otherwise
a datasheet row named in the hand file’s keptRows is reused as when another list has it (a row taken over from a retired list keeps its signed-off facts)
an Enhancement-tagged ability BSData has only as the weapon it gives (no ability profile) is not a failure
